name: Review location quality and close the loop
title: Review location quality and close the loop
description: This is the operational quality loop: inspect missing/ambiguous locations, failed datasets, unindexed archive assets, and ingest errors on a regular cadence. Correct issues at the source record, keep provenance, and re-run the relevant report. As your inventory grows, use the workspace cards and charts to spot changes, then drill into records instead of drawing conclusions from an aggregate alone.
report_description: Find missing, malformed, ambiguous, or low-confidence camera locations. Correct the source record and retain provenance; rerun the report to verify the quality issue is resolved rather than merely hidden.
